sn-image-resume 2026.8.19

- New skill for generating visually designed portfolio-resume images from conversation text.
- Extracts resume details and optional style directions from user input.
- Provides a fixed tall, stacked layout (portfolio-resume style), using prompts tailored via sn-text-optimize.
- Supports customizable aspect ratios, image sizes, and style presets.
- Utilizes a robust two-agent architecture for prompt and image generation, with clear error handling.
- Triggers on phrases like "resume image", "portfolio resume", "简历图", and related keywords.
